description: Live flight-ticket search (flight only, no hotel) from ANY airport — default departure Tirana (TIA) — to any destination, one-way or round trip. Returns the recommended flight plus 2-3 alternatives (airline, times, stops, baggage) and the cheapest direct flight when the headline one has stops. Prices are the TOTAL for the whole party in EUR, our service fee included, INDICATIVE: the fare is fixed at ticketing. Booking = a request on our flights page (search_url); our staff confirms and issues the ticket. Multi-airport cities (London, Milan, Paris, Rome, Brussels, Istanbul) are searched across all their airports — name the real arrival airport (arrival_airports). For beach holidays with flight+hotel+transfers from Tirana use the charter_* tools. LIVE search (not cache) with a limited daily allowance — call it ONCE per user request and reuse the result for follow-up questions. If the answer says live_search=false, give the user search_url (the same search pre-filled on our site, prices live there).

adults.description: Travellers aged 12+ (default 1) — airlines price 12+ as adults.

airline.description: Filter by airline name, e.g. "Wizz Air" (only when the user asks).

cabin.description: Default economy; business only when the user explicitly asks.

children_ages.description: Age of each child on the travel date (REQUIRED when children travel — prices depend on the exact age).

country.description: Optional 2-letter country code of the destination, only to disambiguate (e.g. "CH").

direct_only.description: true = only non-stop flights (only when the user asks).

from.description: Departure city or IATA code (Tirana, Pristina, Skopje / TIA, PRN, SKP). Default Tirana.

return_date.description: Return date YYYY-MM-DD — omit for a one-way ticket.

to.description: Destination city (English name: Geneva, Milan, London) or IATA code in capitals (GVA). For multi-airport cities give the CITY name.
